task_name: Zone and Construct Three Residential Zones to Reach Level 2

when_to_do_it.trigger_condition: When the 'My Sweet Town' City Journal requires creating 3 Residential Zones and the Residential icon shows a '3' badge.
when_to_do_it.strategic_reasoning: Placing all 3 available Residential Zones immediately fulfills the journal objective, and constructing two of them with stored Metal pushes XP over the threshold to reach City Level 2 (unlocking Wood production and +1 Factory).
preconditions: Stored Metal available for initial construction
when_to_do_it.placement_rule: Place the 3 Residential Zones side-by-side along the existing road opposite the first homes.

steps.who: Residential Buildings icon on the right menu

steps.briefing: place three new Residential Zones in a row along the lower side of the road, clicking the green checkmark after each placement.

steps.who: yellow hard hat on the rightmost new Residential Zone

steps.briefing: drag Metal onto the zone to construct it and level up to City Level 2.

steps.who: yellow hard hat on the middle new Residential Zone

steps.briefing: drag Metal onto the middle zone to construct it.
drag Metal into both factory slots.
drag Nails into the production slot.
